name: Nightgarden
world: A walled garden after dark at moonrise: moonflowers unfurl white, night jasmine climbs the wall, a low moon sits behind the foliage, a paper lantern hangs on the path. Peace in the mind is the quiet after the sun goes. Green-black, moonflower white, lunar silver, jasmine pink, lantern ochre — no stars, no sky, a garden.
hero: A low full moon (radial-gradient disc with a soft-light crater speckle) half-hidden behind layered foliage silhouettes (radial-gradient leaf blobs in two darker greens) at the lower right — behind leaves, never behind Maria. image8 (eyes closed, hands on heart) at left, silvered (mix-blend-mode: luminosity over a green-black plate at .85 so some warmth survives), its edge feathered into the foliage with a mask. Three moonflowers (SVG trumpets: five fused petals with a pale radial throat) open along the bottom edge under the H1 in Ovo, moonflower white; the lede in Hanken Grotesk on the stone coping of the garden wall.
signature: Moonflowers opening on scroll: five-petal SVG groups whose petals scale from the throat and unfurl (rotate from a shared origin, staggered) as each section arrives — 'your potential is given room to bloom' — the garden dark at the top of the page and in full white bloom by the Book CTA, which the largest flower frames.

ornaments.phrase: blossom into who you are meant to be
ornaments.element: Moonflower SVGs at #alone, #about and #book (≤8 groups): petals scale(.2→1) + rotate from the throat on reveal, a soft box-shadow glow under the SVG only while opening, then still; the #book bloom is 320px and frames the CTA.

Nine fireflies at the nine tapping points over image6 in the EFT card: 6px dots with layered box-shadow glow that light once in the tapping sequence on reveal, then hold — the only points of light on the page, and only inside that card.

A paper lantern at #session (rounded rectangle, rib lines from a repeating-linear-gradient at .12, inner glow via inset box-shadow in ochre, bamboo frame) with three numbered panels; it turns (rotateY, 3D, once per step on scroll) to bring each panel to the front.

ornaments.phrase: when you are ready, the next step is simple
ornaments.element: The lantern's light pools ahead on the #book flagstone: a warm radial-gradient on the ground that reaches the CTA as the section enters, the step lit before you take it.

The walled garden: a low stone wall (repeating-linear-gradient courses with mortar lines, a coping stone top) runs across the top of #practices and down both sides on desktop; the two pillars sit inside the walled bed.

Night-jasmine vine climbing the wall on the left rail: SVG stem drawn upward with the scroll (stroke-dashoffset), small five-point star flowers in jasmine pink popping open as the stem passes; runs along section tops on mobile.
The moon rises 40px behind the foliage on load while the leaves darken, and leaves a still moon-path (a faint silver radial on the ground) that stays — the quiet after the sun goes.
Brand mark in lunar silver with a 1px moonflower-white inner stroke; section dividers are three jasmine stars on a hairline stem.

motion: Load: moon rises 40px while foliage darkens (1.2s), the three hero moonflowers open (1.6s, staggered). Scroll: vine climbs, flowers open, lantern turns, fireflies light once, the light pool reaches the CTA. Nothing loops. Reduced motion: moon up, flowers open, lantern showing all three panels stacked, fireflies lit.
photos: image8 hero in silver luminosity; image6 in the EFT firefly card; image11 in #about with a soft radial mask so her face is the lit centre; image9 small at #book beside the lantern. Moonlight treatment throughout, never fully saturated. 4 photos.
risk: Stellar distance: no stars, no dots-of-light field, no lines between points — the sky is one moon behind foliage, and the only lit points are the nine fireflies inside the EFT card. Halo distance: no glow behind the portrait; glow belongs to the lantern and the opening flowers only. Enamel distance: green-black #0e1a15 vs saturated emerald. Blossom is shared only with Nouveau (irises) in this batch. Body moonflower white 17px on green-black (≈16:1); pink and ochre for accents ≥18px. Foliage is gradients, not DOM; moonflowers ≤8 SVG groups. Replaces Mycelium.
